numeral.purpose: Every figure a reader compares with another: ledger cells, sub-rows, table figures. DM Mono 400, tabular.

numeral-key.purpose: The page's one total: the hero's Offer Ceiling over its double rule, 54px from 1024px.

numeral-key-sm.purpose: The hero total below 1024px, the walkthrough's second total, plan prices (28px under 380px).

label.purpose: Column heads, the source table's head row, bar titles: 14px at 600, sentence case.

small.purpose: Target lines, notes, captions, the risk line, the footer strip.

ui.purpose: Fields, nav links, the ledger caption, links in running text; 16px so iOS never zooms a field.

display.purpose: The H1 only, in Archivo's semi-condensed cut: 38px below 1024px, easing to 55px at 1280px.

section-sm.purpose: Section headings below 640px; also the plan price under 380px.

h3.purpose: Plan names and the walkthrough's Offer Ceiling label, display voice.

h3-sm.purpose: H3 on phones; defined in the ramp, not yet used on the homepage.

h4.purpose: The opened ledger's row labels from 640px: Archivo at normal width, 600. The hero total's label takes the display voice at this size.

text.purpose: Marketing body at 18px: the hero subhead (46ch), section intros and notes (60-68ch).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The one float shadow (shadow-md and shadow-lg): menus, popovers, the address suggestions, dialogs, the mobile sheet.

shadows.name: float-up
shadows.purpose: The same float cast upward (shadow-float-up) for bars fixed to the bottom edge: the sticky conversion bar and the cookie banner.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: shadow-2xs, shadow-xs and shadow-sm render nothing: no shadow at rest, so a hairline card never also floats.

shadows.name: ledger-bleed
shadows.purpose: Not an elevation: a flat offset fill (no blur, no spread) that runs the binding row's band 0.5rem past the ledger's rules. ledger-bleed on a grid row; ledger-bleed-start and -end on a table row's first and last cell.

focus.name: control
focus.purpose: Every link, button, field, summary and tabbable element. A floor over the primitives' half-transparent rings (about 2.1:1 on paper).

focus.name: menu-item
focus.purpose: Menu items and listbox options (the Learn menu, the address suggestions), where an outline would sit outside the menu.

motion.name: ledger-rule-draw
motion.value: ledger-rule-in 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) 200ms both; scaleX 0 to 1, transform-origin right
motion.purpose: The page's one motion: the double rule under the hero's Offer Ceiling draws in once from the right after the figures paint. Runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; otherwise the rule is static.

motion.name: state
motion.value: transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity; 150ms
motion.purpose: Hover and pressed state changes. Named properties only, never transition: all.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button primitive press feedback; the link variant does not scale.

motion.name: float-menu
motion.value: fade, zoom from 95%, 0.5rem slide from the trigger side; 150ms ease
motion.purpose: Menus open and close. Floats keep their transitions: the one-motion rule is about page content.

motion.name: float-sheet
motion.value: slide from the screen edge; 500ms open, 300ms close, ease-in-out

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: animation-duration and transition-duration 0.001ms !important under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
motion.purpose: Reduced motion collapses every animation and transition, floats included.

narrative.overview:
TrueCap is a ledger: a column of labels, two columns of figures, rules between them, and one number at the bottom with a double rule under it. That object is the product's decision, so it is also the site's signature. The marketing pages stop showing a screenshot of the ledger inside a SaaS layout and show the ledger itself, set in type, with the sample deal's real numbers.

Ledger, not broadsheet. The world is the accountant's columnar pad, the loan estimate and the rate sheet: ruled columns, right-aligned figures, a total rule, a source line. It is not the newspaper: no italic display serif, no dense multi-column editorial grid, no tracked mono labels. That keeps it out of the "broadsheet hairlines" look that generated sites now default to.

Scene, and why light. An agent at a showing reads it on a phone in a lit room or outdoors; the client reads the memo at a desk. Daylight reading on paper, so the system is light-only by decision: there is no dark theme and no toggle, and the `.dark` block in `app/globals.css` stays unwired.

Spend boldness in one place. The hero ledger is the loud element: the largest figure on the page, the one double rule, the one motion. Everything around it is quiet: plain paper, rules, sentence case, one blue.
keyCharacteristics: A ledger: a column of labels, two columns of figures, rules between them, and one number at the bottom with a double rule under it.
Newsprint paper and graphite ink; Signal Blue is the only color that means "act here".
Archivo semi-condensed at 750 for H1-H3 and plan names, Archivo at normal width for text, DM Mono tabular for figures.
Rules carry the structure; plan cards are the one card on marketing pages.
Light only, no shadow at rest, one motion moment per page.
Controls at least 44×44px with a 3px Signal Blue focus outline.

rules.name: Spend boldness in one place
rules.body: The hero ledger is the loud element: the largest figure on the page, the one double rule, the one motion. Everything around it is quiet: plain paper, rules, sentence case, one blue.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: A figure that will be compared with another figure is set in DM Mono with tabular numerals: ledger cells, prices on plan cards, metric values, the Offer Ceiling. Prose numbers stay in the text face.

rules.name: Sentence case everywhere
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere, table heads included. Acronyms stay acronyms (DSCR, NOI, CoC, HUD, FRED). No `uppercase` utility outside a real acronym.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color that means "act here": buttons, links, focus rings, the active nav item.

rules.name: The Sign Rule
rules.body: Green and red are earned only by the sign of a number or by a pass/fail against a target, never for emphasis.

rules.name: White means write
rules.body: White (`field`) is used only where a person types: the address field, form inputs, editable cells in the analyzer. Everything else sits on paper.

rules.name: The Always-Light Rule
rules.body: The system is light-only by decision: there is no dark theme and no toggle, and the `.dark` block in `app/globals.css` stays unwired.

rules.name: Radius by role
rules.body: 0 for printed things: rules, tables, the ledger, sections, FAQ rows. 2px for tags and chips. 4px for controls: buttons and fields. 6px for plan cards. 10px for things that float: menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets. Full round only for switch tracks, avatars and status dots.

rules.name: Rules carry the structure
rules.body: Soft rule (1px) between rows. Rule (1px) under table heads and between sections. Heavy rule (2px, ink) opens a ledger or a major section, the way the Loan Estimate and the FT open a module. The double rule (two 1px ink lines 3px apart) marks a final total and nothing else.

rules.name: No shadow at rest
rules.body: One float shadow, for menus, dialogs and the sticky bar. Hairline border plus a wide shadow is banned. Every float keeps a 1px rule edge under that shadow (menus, the address suggestions, the mobile sheet, the bottom bars), where raised paper meets paper; the ban reads on objects at rest.

rules.name: Motion: one moment
rules.body: On the homepage the double rule under the Offer Ceiling draws in once (520ms, ease-out) after the figures have painted, so there is no layout shift and no delay to the largest paint. Nothing else fades or slides in. The rule is about page content: floats (menus, popovers, dialogs, the mobile sheet) keep their open and close transitions, and reduced motion collapses those too.

rules.name: No eyebrows
rules.body: No label, kicker or pill above a heading anywhere.

rules.name: No arrow suffixes
rules.body: Link text never ends in "→"; buttons carry no trailing arrow icon; nothing nudges sideways on hover. Links are Signal Blue, underlined (1px, 3px offset), and that is enough.

rules.name: Cards only for discrete objects the user compares
rules.body: Plan cards are the one card on marketing pages. Feature lists, the sources block, the FAQ, the founder block and proof use rules, columns and space. No nested containers.

rules.name: Focus
rules.body: Focus is a 3px Signal Blue outline with a 2px offset on every control. Menu items and listbox options (the address suggestions) show focus as the band plus an inset 2px Signal Blue ring instead, since an outline would sit outside the menu.

dos: Do take every color, radius and font from tokens.
Do set compared figures in DM Mono tabular.
Do keep one Disclaimer per marketing page.
Do keep controls at 44px or more with the 3px focus ring.
donts: Don't add a dark theme, a second accent, gradient text, colored glows, an eyebrow, an arrow suffix, an uppercase label, a card around a list, a shadow at rest, `transition-all`, or a second motion.
